title: Entity growth batch 01 — OKX Wallet
notes: Candidate-only breadth-growth record under issue #191. Canonical publication prohibited until batch review completes.

entities.summary: Self-custody multichain wallet ecosystem from OKX spanning mobile, browser, web and newer agent-oriented wallet surfaces.
entities.notes: The initial OKX Wallet launch date remains unresolved in this batch. A 2025 first-party article says the wallet had been introduced three years earlier, but WLR does not back-calculate a precise launch date from relative wording.

products.summary: Standalone OKX Wallet mobile application separated from the primary OKX exchange app and distributed on iOS and Android.
products.notes: The standalone OKX Wallet App was explicitly announced as available on 2025-04-16. This does not define the earlier entity-level wallet launch date.

evidence.title: OKX Wallet now supports social login
evidence.notes: Current first-party wallet announcement establishes an active self-custodial OKX Wallet ecosystem across app, browser extension, Web and Agent surfaces.

evidence.title: Announcing the new OKX Wallet app
evidence.notes: First-party announcement states that the standalone OKX Wallet App was available on the App Store and Google Play on 2025-04-16.
